MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 24

2. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 40

3. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 26
   C. 169
   D. 170

4. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 1
   C. 57
   D. 56

5. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 41
   C. 40
   D. 13

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 14
   C. 10
   D. 12

7. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 9
   C. 82
   D. 81

8. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 144

9. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 7
   C. 49
   D. 50

10. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x > 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x = 5

11. Solve for x: x + 5 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 5
   C. 12
   D. 17

12. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 12
   C. 32
   D. 33

13. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 11
   C. 24
   D. 25

14. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 90

15. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 22
   C. 11
   D. 121

16. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
